scores.label: A
scores.note: No zeros. All drop 'to store the energy' (implied by batteries) and the 'One problem' framing, and clip 'the sun' to 'sun'. Options 1 and 5 are clean and precise ('intermittent'). Option 2 'vary' is vaguer, option 3 'unreliable' slightly stronger, option 4 has a loose dangling 'needing'. The negation_changed flags are faithful rewordings of 'does not always shine/blow'.
